literal_meaning: রপ্তানি করে রপ্তানি করে (exporting bit by bit)
example_sentences_in_bangla: রপ্তে রপ্তে তার সব কাজ শেষ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Little by little, all his work got finished.
Life's experience grows bit by bit.
note: This idiom emphasizes the value of steady, incremental effort in Bengali cultural context.
